{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders, refunded orders, and non-converted orders
df_clean = df[
    (df['revenue'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['converted'] == 1)
]

# Final population size
final_population = len(df_clean)
print(f'Final population size: {final_population}')

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().round(2)
print('\nAverage revenue per converted order by channel:')
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Compute the difference in average revenue between channels
email_avg = avg_revenue_by_channel['email']
paid_search_avg = avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']
difference = email_avg - paid_search_avg
print(f'\nDifference (email - paid_search): {difference:.2f} USD')"}
